# pushward Provider

Manages a PushWard organization: its name, members, groups, device tags and the devices carrying them, routing rules and sending keys, and on the Enterprise plan its verified email domains and single sign-on. It authenticates with an org admin key (`hlo_...`), which an owner or admin creates in the [PushWard console](https://console.pushward.app). The organization is the key's own.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    pushward = {
      source = "mac-lucky/pushward"
    }
  }
}

# The key is read from PUSHWARD_ORG_API_TOKEN when api_key is not set.
provider "pushward" {
  api_key = var.pushward_org_key
}

variable "pushward_org_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) Org admin key (`hlo_...`). A `manage` key acts as an admin. A `read` key acts as a viewer: it reads the organization, members, devices, groups, tags and routing rules, but not sending keys or open invites, so a plan with a `pushward_org_key` or a pending `pushward_org_member` needs a `manage` key. Defaults to the `PUSHWARD_ORG_API_TOKEN` environment variable.
- `api_url` (String) API base URL. Plain `http://` to anything but this machine gets a warning, since it sends the key unencrypted. Defaults to `PUSHWARD_API_URL`, then `https://api.pushward.app`.
